# f5xc_known_label (Data Source)

Get Label Request Get Label Request is used in following way namespace = shared if query = QUERY_ALL_LABELS than key and value are ignored and complete list of labels from current tenants shared namespace and ves-io/shared namespace are returned if query = QUERY_EXACT_LABELS than label matching exact key and value are returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io/shared namespace if query = QUERY_VALUE_PREFIX_LABELS than labels matching key=value are returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io shared namespace are returned if query = QUERY_KEY_PREFIX_LABELS than value is ignored and  labels matching key are returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io shared namespace are returned

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Known Label - Full

data "f5xc_known_label" "example" {
  key       = f5xc_known_label.example.key
  namespace = f5xc_known_label.example.namespace
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) description Description of what this label means
- `key` (String) key Label key
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `value` (String) value Label value
